text: Target workflow, 30 seconds: Describe this as the planned AI mapping workflow. The repository contains assets/ASTM-UniFormat.xlsx, but the current frontend does not implement standard ingestion, AI classification updates, or model write-back. A classification mapping is not itself proof of regulatory compliance. Compliance conclusions need the applicable requirement and supporting property evidence. Sources: user brief; assets/ASTM-UniFormat.xlsx; frontend/src/lib/model.ts.

name: Title 2
text: Live demo sequence
textPreview: Live demo sequence

text: Live demo, approximately 90 seconds: Open Sample model. Select a wall from the model tree. Inspect its properties. Ask Tell me about the selected element. Type Isolate selected element to demonstrate the local command. Restore with Show all. Use Draft an issue, enter a meaningful title, review it, and save. Reopen the saved issue to restore its viewpoint. Filter the sheet and choose Export .xlsx. General chat answers are mocked, so do not present them as live Astra reasoning. Sources: frontend/src/lib/review.ts; frontend/src/components/ChatPanel.tsx; frontend/src/lib/model.ts.

text: Status, 25 seconds: The review tool layer exposes ten tools. It registers when the browser provides modelContext and otherwise falls back to local tools. Measurement returns approximate world-axis bounding boxes in metres, not exact quantities for estimating. Review issues persist in browser local storage. Next work includes live model integration, standard-backed reasoning, and approved mapping persistence. Sources: frontend/src/lib/webmcp.ts; frontend/src/lib/review.ts; frontend/README.md.
